name: Sweets & Dragons
detailed_description:
We have opened an otherworldly maid cafe!

Sweets & Dragons is a management simulation game in which you manage a maid cafe with a beautiful maid android as your partner.

You can instruct your beautiful maid androids to renovate the shop to attract customers and serve them food to earn money.

You can then use the money you earn to improve the Maid Cafes facilities and develop a variety of menu items to earn even more money.

Training beautiful maid android.

With the money you earn, you can manage your shop and train a beautiful maid android named Tsubasa.

By training Tsubasa, you will be able to improve her performance and run your shop faster and with more variety.

The story will progress as the shop is renovated, expanded, and the performance of the Tsubasa is improved.

The Story

It has been several years since the "Dragon", a great disaster, appeared in the Empire. Many soldiers and adventurers were active in the realm to defeat the dragon.

One day, a small incident occurred in a remote port city in the empire. A powerful dragon had somehow destroyed an old cafe and left.

The owner of the cafe barely escaped, but what he saw were the ruins of the cruelly destroyed cafe and a battered android.

The owner rescued the android, repaired it, and rebuilt the destroyed cafe.
